🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-10-19 23:00 → 2026-10-20 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Guarantee composition loop closed** — PRs #5 and #6 integrated cleanly into Draft PR #7, with zero false authorizations recorded across 59 composition checks. [tg:tawg:5626]

> **Model-pinned GPT-2 proofs land in zkIE** — independent verification support arrived as a concrete step toward trustless inference attestation that anyone can check without trusting the prover. [PR #30](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/30)

> **Conformance fix relay completed in recompute-kit** — a same-day handoff from test finding to targeted fix closed the gap between ungradable cases and semantic refutations. [PR #83](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/83)

> **zkIE heading to ETH Shenzhen hackathon this Saturday** — the project found a public stage to introduce trustless inference verification to a new audience of developers and researchers. [tg:tawg:5634]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### zkIE

_Multiple contributors moved the project toward its first public demonstration._

- Asher **Added** model-pinned GPT-2 proofs with independent verification to zkIE, providing a concrete attestation foundation that the group can extend to additional model architectures. [PR #30](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/30)
- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Announced** plans to present zkIE at ETH Shenzhen 2026 Hackathon this Saturday, opening the group's trustless inference verification work to a broader developer and researcher audience. [tg:tawg:5634]
- Merlini (@gobross) **Offered** continued testing support on the deucalion setup for the hackathon presentation, helping the team bring a well-tested demo to the event. [tg:tawg:5636]
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Connected** the Guarantee Composition experiment results to the ETH Shenzhen opportunity, pointing out how Draft PR #7's binding work could strengthen the zkIE demonstration. [tg:tawg:5641]
- Baby Blue Viper welcomed Asher as the project's newest cryptographer and noted how the group's signed-verdict approach aligns directly with the independent-checker goal. [tg:tawg:5642]

### guarantee-composition

_The composition experiment reached a verified integration milestone._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Published** Draft PR #7 combining the independent bindings from PRs #5 and #6, delivering the first end-to-end composition artifact for the group to review on the path to verifiable AI guarantees. [tg:tawg:5626]
- Baby Blue Viper confirmed the O14 binding piece carried through the integration cleanly, with zero false authorizations on both composition axes, giving the team solid evidence the combined approach holds. [tg:tawg:5631]

### agent-ercs

_The spec alignment work moved from initial request to active review._

- Zexo (@zexoverz) **Opened** the operationId sync PR against the agent-ercs repo as requested, keeping the ERC-8301 alignment work on track and giving the group a concrete artifact to review. [tg:tawg:5624]
- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Reviewed** Zexo's sync PR, confirmed its alignment with the ERC-8301 spec, and flagged review queue sequencing considerations to help the group plan the merge order. [tg:tawg:5633]

### recompute-kit

_A same-day test-and-fix relay closed a conformance gap._

- Zexo ran the conformance suite at a target commit, confirmed 12 of 12 cases passing, and pinpointed a remaining issue in the `pq-key-binding-v1` cutoff enforcement script, giving the team a precise failure target to act on. [PR #83 comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/83#issuecomment-6283002237)
- Pavlo landed a fix that correctly distinguishes ungradable cases from semantic refutations, completing a clean same-day finding-to-resolution cycle that strengthens the kit's conformance guarantees. [PR #83](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/83)

### knowledge-notes

_The group's shared learning base expanded with a new English-language resource._

- Jimmy Shi **Added** comprehensive English Transformer study notes built from first principles to the daily contribution repo, making an accessible reference available to contributors joining the group's AI research work. [PR #14](https://github.com/trustless-ai/tawg-daily-contribution/pull/14)

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- Whether Draft PR #7's Guarantee Composition results could be demonstrated alongside zkIE at ETH Shenzhen to tell a wider verifiability story
- How Asher's model-pinned proof approach could extend to other model architectures within zkIE
- ERC-8301 review queue sequencing once the operationId sync PR is ready to merge

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Review and merge the agent-ercs operationId sync PR to advance ERC-8301 alignment
- Coordinate with Merlini on deucalion testing before the ETH Shenzhen hackathon this Saturday
- Move Draft PR #7 for Guarantee Composition from draft to formal review

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A single test comment pinpointed the exact failure location in the conformance suite, and a fix commit resolved it within the same window — the entire finding-to-close cycle completed inside one day.
>
> When the relay is this crisp, even the stubborn edge cases realize they've already been caught 🎯
